## Purpose

This vignette walks through **each analysis section** in `DEGreports` and
shows **how genes, pathways, modules, and TF activities are computed and
linked**. Companion vignettes:

- `vignette("DEGreports")` — how to run the package  
- `vignette("DEGreports-modules")` — function arguments and defaults  

Organism (human / mouse) is inferred from gene symbols via
`detect_organism()`; row names should be HGNC / MGI symbols.

Flow diagrams below need a network connection once (Mermaid CDN) when viewing
the knitted HTML.

---

## End-to-end pipeline flow

`run_deseq2()` runs stages in a fixed order. Optional modules are
skipped when their `run_*` flag is `FALSE` (or when a stage errors and is
caught). Use `run_deseq2(mode = "lrt")` for time-course designs (see LRT section
below).

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  A[DESeqDataSet raw counts] --> B[run_qc]
  B --> C[run_counts_export]
  B --> D[run_distance_pca]
  B --> E[run_diffexp_pipeline]
  E --> F[run_cspa_marker_pipeline]
  E --> G[run_gsea_pipeline]
  G --> H[run_gsea_overlap_pipeline]
  B --> I[run_wgcna_pipeline]
  E --> J[run_decoupler_tf_pipeline]
  E --> K[run_viper_pipeline]
  E --> L[run_ppi_pipeline]
  I --> L
  E --> M[run_multihit_pipeline]
  G --> M
  J --> M
  K --> M
  F --> M
  B --> N[render_report + dds.rds]
  D --> N
  E --> N
  F --> N
  G --> N
  H --> N
  I --> N
  J --> N
  K --> N
  L --> N
  M --> N
</pre>
```

**Artifact layout** (under `save_dir`):

| Folder | Produced by |
|---|---|
| `qc/` | `run_qc()`, `run_counts_export()` (`counts/`), `run_distance_pca()` (`distance/`) |
| `deseq2/` | DE + per-contrast CSPA (`<contrast>/cspa/`) + PPI (`<contrast>/ppi/`) |
| `clusterprofiler/<contrast>/` | GSEA + `gsea_overlap/` |
| `wgcna/` (incl. `<Module_N>/ppi/`), `decoupler-tf/`, `decoupler-ccc/`, `viper/`, `gsva/` | optional modules |
| `ppi/`, `multihit/` | LRT-cluster PPI + summary |
| `index.html`, `dds.rds` | report + QC-filtered object |

---

## 1. Quality control — which genes are kept?

**Input.** Raw counts in a `DESeqDataSet`.  
**Output.** Filtered `dds` (size factors estimated); QC tables / library
plots; per-sample detected-gene and total-transcript counts (Sample QC).

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart LR
  R[All genes] --> MT{remove_mt?}
  MT -->|drop MT| VDJ{remove_vdj?}
  MT -->|keep| VDJ
  VDJ -->|drop BCR/TCR pattern| XY{remove_xy?}
  VDJ -->|keep| XY
  XY -->|drop X/Y via gene_chr| EXPR[Expression filter]
  XY -->|keep| EXPR
  EXPR -->|cpm: drop bottom percentile by mean CPM| KEEP[Retained genes]
  EXPR -->|count: keep genes above min_count| KEEP
  EXPR -->|NULL: no expr filter| KEEP
  KEEP --> SF[estimateSizeFactors]
</pre>
```

Defaults used by the orchestrator: `filter_method = "cpm"`,
`cpm_percentile = 0.05`. Metadata is stored on
`metadata(dds)$degreports_qc` for the report (including
`sample_qc_table`).

---

## 2. Counts export and sample structure

**Counts export** writes raw, VST, rlog, and CPM matrices (plus a
batch-corrected VST matrix when `batch` or `pair` is set, from
`limma::removeBatchEffect()` protecting `var`). These are for downstream use;
the DE model still uses the QC-filtered raw counts, with `batch` and `pair`
as terms in the design.

**Distance / PCA** (`run_distance_pca`):

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  D[QC dds] --> V[VST]
  V --> B{batch set?}
  B -->|removeBatchEffect for viz only| P[PCA + scree + loadings]
  B -->|none| P
  P --> A[PC–covariate association heatmap top 15 PCs]
  V --> S[Sample Spearman similarity heatmap]
</pre>
```

Batch correction here does not change the DE design matrix -- DESeq2 keeps
using raw counts with `batch` as a covariate. The corrected matrix is shared
with the sample-level modules (WGCNA, GSVA, ULM, VIPER, CSPA), so the PCA and
those modules always agree on what was corrected. Association heatmap tests PC
scores vs `batch` / grouping `var` / `time` (LRT) when those columns are passed
as `assoc_vars`.

---

## 3. Differential expression — how are DEGs defined?

**Contrasts.** From `var` (length 1–3), `expand_contrast_specs()` builds
pairwise and one-vs-rest labels. With two or three factors, each factor's
**main effect** is always expanded — its comparisons taken across every level
of the other factors (`C_vs_noC`), fitted on all samples with an additive
design so the other factors are adjusted for. `include_interactions = TRUE`
adds **difference-of-differences** contrasts on top
(`C_vs_noC_x_K_vs_noK_in_CB`: does the K effect differ between C and noC inside
CB), each a combination of coefficients from a single fit of the product design
on all samples. A factor with three or more levels is compared one-vs-rest
(`CA_vs_CB+CC_x_K_vs_noK_in_C`), the pooled side being a mean of coefficients
with equal weight per level.

**Per contrast** (`run_diffexp` / `run_diffexp_pipeline`):

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  D[QC dds + design] --> FIT[DESeq fit]
  FIT --> RES[results: LFC, SE, stat, pvalue, padj]
  RES --> SHR{shrinkage}
  SHR -->|ashr / apeglm / normal| LFC[Shrunk log2FoldChange]
  SHR -->|none| LFC2[Unshrunken LFC]
  LFC --> RANK[rank_score from ranking metric]
  LFC2 --> RANK
  RANK --> SIG["sig = padj less than alpha AND abs LFC greater than lfc_threshold"]
  SIG --> DIR[direction up / down / ns from sign of LFC]
  SIG --> PLOTS[MA, volcano, DEG table]
</pre>
```

**Fixed by the pipeline.** shrinkage `"ashr"`, `alpha = 0.05`,
`lfc_threshold = 0.5`. `ranking` is still an argument and defaults to
`"log2FoldChange"` (so `rank_score ≈ LFC`). Call `run_diffexp_pipeline()`
directly to change the fixed values.

**Gene-level objects used later:**

- Significant DEGs (`sig`) → CSPA selection, PPI seeds, multihit DEG bit  
- Full ranked list (`rank_score`) → GSEA ranks  
- Wald `stat` → contrast-level decoupleR / VIPER  

---

## 4. CSPA surface markers

Among each contrast’s DEGs, intersect with Cell Surface Protein Atlas symbols
(human list; mouse via orthologs), rank by `|rank_score|` / `|LFC|`, keep the
top **25** per contrast (**10** per degPatterns cluster in LRT mode), and plot
**all-sample** VST heatmaps (per contrast + combined union).

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart LR
  DEG[sig DEGs] --> INT[Intersect CSPA gene list]
  INT --> TOP[Top n_markers by abs rank_score]
  TOP --> HM[VST heatmap all samples]
</pre>
```

---

## 5. GSEA — how are pathways scored?

**Ranks.** For each contrast, genes are ordered by `rank_score` (same metric
as DE). Duplicate symbols are collapsed (max |score|).

**Gene sets.** MSigDB collections via `msigdbr` (human sets; mouse genes
mapped with orthologs when needed). Default collections exclude HALLMARK
unless you add it.

**Enrichment.** Primary engine is `fgsea` (`run_gsea` / `run_gsea_pipeline`).
Optional parallel `clusterProfiler::GSEA()` when `run_clusterprofiler = TRUE`.

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  DE[Per-contrast DE table] --> RK[Named rank vector]
  RK --> FG[fgsea vs each MSigDB collection]
  FG --> TAB[pathway NES padj leadingEdge]
  TAB --> BP[Barplot top_n_plot up and down by NES]
  TAB --> BC[Barcode panel]
  TAB --> LE[leadingEdge gene members]
</pre>
```

**Pathway significance** for downstream overlap uses `padj < alpha`
(pipeline `alpha`, default `0.05`), pooling collections **within one
contrast**.

---

## 6. GSEA leading-edge overlap

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  P[Significant pathways padj less than alpha] --> LE[Parse leadingEdge sets]
  LE --> J[Pairwise Jaccard matrix]
  J --> BC[binary_cut chooses k]
  J --> HC[hclust on 1 minus Jaccard]
  BC --> K[k]
  K --> CT[cutree hc at k]
  HC --> CT
  CT --> HM[Square heatmap + dendrograms]
  CT --> WC[Side word clouds]
</pre>
```

Splits, dendrograms, and word clouds share the **same** `cutree` partition
(`k` from binary_cut). Artifacts live under
`clusterprofiler/<contrast>/gsea_overlap/`.

---

## 7. WGCNA — modules from co-expression (not DE)

Independent of contrasts: uses **all samples’** VST profiles.

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  V[VST expression] --> SFT[pickSoftThreshold powers through 20]
  SFT --> CAP[Select power at most power_cap 15]
  CAP --> NET[blockwiseModules signed network]
  NET --> MOD[Modules by size; grey to Unassigned]
  MOD --> ME[Module eigengenes]
  ME --> TR[Correlate MEs vs grouping var]
  MOD --> HUB[Hub genes by abs kME]
  MOD --> ORA[fora ORA per module and collection]
</pre>
```

Unassigned / grey is excluded from ORA (not a coherent module).

---

## 8. TF activity — decoupleR (CollecTRI + ULM)

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  NET[CollecTRI TF to target network] --> S[Sample ULM on VST]
  NET --> C[Contrast ULM on Wald stat]
  S --> SH[Sample TF heatmap]
  C --> CB[Contrast TF barplots]
</pre>
```

---

## 9. VIPER (bcellViper regulon)

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  REG[bcellViper human B-cell regulon] --> MAP{mouse?}
  MAP -->|babelgene to human| VIP[viper on scaled VST]
  MAP -->|human symbols| VIP
  REG --> MS[msviper on contrast Wald stats]
  VIP --> SH[Sample TF heatmap]
  MS --> BC[Contrast barcode plots]
</pre>
```

---

## 10. STRING PPI

Seeds = significant DEGs (or WGCNA module members) → map to STRING → induced
subgraph → community / hub layout. Embedded on DE and WGCNA report pages.

---

## 11. Multi-hit genes — integrating layers

Per contrast, each gene scores **+1** for each layer that hits it:

| Layer | Hit rule |
|---|---|
| DEG | `sig` |
| GSEA | In **any** significant pathway leading edge (0/1) |
| VIPER | Significant TF after ortholog map (`padj < alpha`) |
| decoupleR | Significant source (`p_value < alpha`) |
| CSPA | Selected CSPA marker for that contrast |

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  G[Genes] --> S[score = deg + gsea + viper + decoupler-tf + decoupler-ccc + cspa]
  S --> DIR[Split by DEG LFC sign up vs down]
  DIR --> TOP[Top top_n per direction]
  TOP --> PLOT[Bidirectional multihit barplot]
</pre>
```

Shown on the dedicated **Multihit** HTML page (`multihit/multihit.html`,
after VIPER in the nav).

---

## Data dependencies (who needs whom)

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart LR
  QC[Filtered dds] --> DE[DE tables]
  QC --> DIST[PCA]
  QC --> WGCNA
  QC --> CSPA
  QC --> DEC[decoupleR]
  QC --> VIP[VIPER]
  DE --> GSEA
  DE --> CSPA
  DE --> DEC
  DE --> VIP
  DE --> PPI
  DE --> MH[multihit]
  GSEA --> OV[GSEA overlap]
  GSEA --> MH
  WGCNA --> PPI
  CSPA --> MH
  DEC --> MH
  VIP --> MH
</pre>
```

---

## Report pages vs calculation modules

| HTML page | Main calculations shown |
|---|---|
| Index | Run summary, links to section pages |
| QC | Sample QC table, library QC, PCA (+ association heatmap), similarity |
| DESeq2 | Hub: up/down DEG summary; per-contrast MA / volcano / DEG table, PPI, CSPA |
| clusterProfiler | Hub: up/down pathway summary; per-collection GSEA + overlap (Wald) or cluster ORA (LRT) |
| WGCNA | Soft-threshold, modules, trait heatmaps, ORA, module PPI |
| decoupleR / VIPER | Sample TF activities + contrast (Wald) or per-cluster (LRT) TFs |
| Multihit | Cross-analysis top genes (Wald barplots / LRT tables) |

Hub pages list contrasts, grouped into main effects and interactions; heavy
figures live on **per-contrast HTML** under `deseq2/<contrast>/` and
`clusterprofiler/<contrast>/` (e.g.
`deseq2/C_vs_noC_x_K_vs_noK_in_CB/`).

---

## LRT / time-course flow (`run_deseq2(mode = "lrt")`)

```{=html}
<pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
  A[DESeqDataSet] --> B[run_qc]
  B --> C[run_distance_pca]
  B --> D[run_diffexp_lrt_pipeline]
  D --> E[run_degpatterns_pipeline]
  E --> F[run_lrt_cspa_heatmap]
  E --> G[run_cluster_ora_pipeline]
  E --> H[lrt_clusters_diffexp_for_tf]
  H --> I[run_decoupler_tf_pipeline]
  H --> J[run_viper_pipeline]
  E --> K[lrt_clusters_as_wgcna_like]
  B --> L[run_wgcna_pipeline]
  K --> M[run_ppi_pipeline]
  L --> M
  D --> M
  E --> N[run_multihit_lrt_pipeline]
  I --> N
  J --> N
  L --> N
  B --> O[render_report]
  C --> O
  D --> O
  E --> O
  F --> O
  G --> O
  I --> O
  J --> O
  L --> O
  M --> O
  N --> O
</pre>
```

Key differences from Wald mode:

- Nested LRT full/reduced models via `expand_lrt_specs()` (no signed LFC
  ranking → **no GSEA**; cluster ORA instead).
- Significant genes clustered with **degPatterns**; PPI / CSPA / TF /
  multihit are **per cluster**.
- Multihit page shows **tables** (top 10 genes × LRT DEG / WGCNA /
  decoupleR / VIPER), not directional barplots.
- Default CSPA is top **10** genes per cluster.

---

## Minimal mental model

1. **Filter genes** (QC) → expression universe for everything else.  
2. **Test genes** (DESeq2 Wald or LRT) → `sig`, ranks / LRT `stat`.  
3. **Test pathways** — GSEA on Wald ranks, or ORA on LRT clusters.  
4. **Relate pathways** (Jaccard overlap, Wald) and **relate genes across
   methods** (multihit).  
5. **Optional structure**: co-expression modules (WGCNA), TF networks
   (decoupleR / VIPER), protein networks (STRING), surfaceome (CSPA).
